subjects.relationship: The primary obstacle and safety-critical object the ego vehicle must respond to
subjects.location: center of frame, mid-distance ahead in the lane
subjects.orientation: rear facing the camera, aligned along the road away from the ego vehicle
subjects.action: stopped with flashing red lights and extended stop arm while unloading children
subjects.state_changes: Remains stationary; red lights continue flashing throughout, stop arm stays extended.

subjects.appearance_details: Wearing backpacks and casual clothing, carrying bags, small in stature
subjects.relationship: Vulnerable road users the ego vehicle must protect by stopping
subjects.location: right mid-ground, between the bus and the sidewalk
subjects.orientation: moving rightward and slightly away from the camera
subjects.action: walking from the bus door toward the sidewalk
subjects.state_changes: Continue walking toward and onto the sidewalk over the clip.

background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban road lined with residential homes, mature trees, driveways, and a paved sidewalk running along the right side. Lawns and low hedges border the road, with parked cars and mailboxes visible along the curb. The road has a single lane in each direction with a painted center line. The atmosphere is calm and everyday, typical of a residential neighborhood during a school-run hour.

lighting.direction: high sun, front-lit from upper left casting consistent shadows
lighting.shadows: Sharp, consistent shadows cast by the bus, trees, and children onto the road surface
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, natural illumination with good visibility, vivid yellow of the bus and saturated red warning lights standing out clearly

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective down the road with the school bus dominating the middle distance, sidewalk and children framed to the right, converging road lines drawing the eye forward
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant school-bus yellow and red warning lights against gray asphalt, green foliage, and blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane markings, sidewalk paving joints, and roadside trees

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's perspective
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the school bus and road ahead

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS scenario demonstrating correct response to a stopped school bus

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels forward along the suburban road, approaching the stopped yellow school bus with flashing red lights ahead.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
Ego vehicle comes to a complete stop well behind the bus and remains fully stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Center of frame on the bus rear, visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Identifies the vehicle as a school bus

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: White uppercase letters on a red octagonal stop arm
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Left side of the bus, extended and visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Legal signal requiring vehicles to stop

segments.description: The ego vehicle drives forward on the two-lane suburban road toward the stopped school bus, whose red lights flash and stop arm is extended.
segments.key_changes: Bus grows larger in frame as the ego vehicle approaches; children begin exiting toward the sidewalk.
segments.camera: Forward motion at a steady moderate speed.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The ego vehicle reaches a complete stop well behind the bus and remains fully stationary for the remainder of the clip. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, ego vehicle travels forward along the suburban road, approaching the stopped yellow school bus with flashing red lights ahead. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient suburban sounds of a light breeze and distant birdsong, the low hum of the ego vehicle's engine gradually diminishing as it slows, faint tire and braking noise, and the rhythmic soft clicking of the school bus warning lights, with faint children's voices in the background. No music or speech from within the vehicle.
